Caldwell-Pope will clear waivers on Tuesday at 5 PM ET. The Sixers could also waive-and-stretch Broome to open up a roster spot. Jabari Walker could also get waived to make room, but the Sixers reportedly prefer to keep the forward. Walker's $2.6 million salary is non-guaranteed until January 10.
